conventions: rectangular FFT bandpass + Hilbert; 18 phase bins; mean amplitude per bin; normalized Tort MI; envelope Pearson correlation
undefined_policy: weak band amplitude, empty phase bins with nan policy, or near-constant AAC envelope -> NaN; rows excluded from regression
scaling: fit train only; Ridge refit train+validation
alignment: original row order required; available labels checked
r2: raw; constant targets undefined; no clipping
